[Intro]
[A]

[Verse 1]
[A]The earth can shake
The sky come down
The mounttains all
Fall to the ground
But I will fear
None of these things
Shelter me
Lord underneath your wings

[Verse 2]
[A]Dark waters rise
and thunder pounds
The wheels of war
are going round
And all the walls
Are crumbling
Shelter me
Lord underneath your wings
Shelter me
Lord underneath your wings

[Chorus]
[F]
Hide me underneath your wings
[D]
Hide me deep inside your heart
[F]In your
refuge cover me
The [E]world can shake but
Lord I'm making [D]you my hiding

[Verse 3]
[A]place. The wind will blow
the rain can pour
the deluge breaks
the tempest roars
but in the storm
my spirit sings
Oh shelter me
Lord underneath your wings
Shelter me
Lord underneath your wings

[Solo]
[A]

[Chorus]
[F]
Hide me underneath your wings
[D]
Hide me deep inside your heart

refuge cover me

Lord I'm making [D]you my hiding

[A]place. Now on the day
you come for me,
some day when time
no more shall be
I'll say Death
Where is your sting ?
Shelter me
Lord underneath your wings
Shelter me
